issues.description: The shell joint, screw holes, sensor window and charging contacts have no specified sealing method for saltwater use.
issues.fix: Define gaskets or overmoulded seals at every opening, control seal compression in the assembly drawing, and validate the assembled band to a specified ingress rating.
issues.rule_citation: Specify and test enclosure ingress protection for the intended exposure — IEC 60529.

issues.description: The LiPo battery has no specified protection circuit, retention method or clearance from screw tips and shell pinch points.
issues.fix: Specify a protected cell or battery protection circuit, a positive retention feature, and assembly clearances; qualify the complete battery assembly.
issues.rule_citation: Portable lithium battery safety requirements — IEC 62133-2.

issues.description: The self-tapping screws are specified without an approved screw type, boss engagement depth or installation torque, risking cracked bosses or stripped threads.
issues.fix: Select a thread-forming screw for PC/ABS and validate pilot, engagement, torque and repeated assembly on moulded samples.
issues.rule_citation: Size plastic bosses and pilot holes to the selected thread-forming screw and verify installation torque — SPIROL design guidelines for self-tapping screws in plastics.

issues.description: The white LSR strap has no specified resistance to UV, saltwater, sunscreen or repeated flexing.
issues.fix: Specify an outdoor-grade LSR compound and acceptance tests for ageing, chemical exposure and flex fatigue.
issues.rule_citation: Evaluate weathering of nonmetallic materials under UV exposure — ASTM G154.

issues.description: Individual shell mating-face tolerances and the split-line limit do not define an achievable assembled stack-up, especially around the seal and sensor window.
issues.fix: Add assembly datums, a gap-and-flush stack-up, and functional tolerances for seal compression and window position.
issues.rule_citation: Define functional datums and tolerance relationships on assembly drawings — ISO 1101 and ISO 5459.

issues.description: Minimum wall draft is 1.33°: enough for a polished finish, short of the ~3° a textured finish ('MT-11010 light texture · Warm white #EDEBE6') needs.
issues.fix: Increase draft to 3° on textured faces, or specify a lighter texture / polished finish.
issues.rule_citation: Draft ≥1° plus 1° per 0.025 mm texture depth — Protolabs injection molding design guidelines; measured with text-to-cad DFM skill (mold_tool.py, MIT) ported to OCCT

issues.description: The shell joint, screw holes, sensor window and charging contacts have no specified sealing method for saltwater use.
issues.fix: Define gaskets or overmoulded seals at every opening, control seal compression in the assembly drawing, and validate the assembled band to a specified ingress rating.
issues.rule_citation: Specify and test enclosure ingress protection for the intended exposure — IEC 60529.

issues.description: The LiPo battery has no specified protection circuit, retention method or clearance from screw tips and shell pinch points.
issues.fix: Specify a protected cell or battery protection circuit, a positive retention feature, and assembly clearances; qualify the complete battery assembly.
issues.rule_citation: Portable lithium battery safety requirements — IEC 62133-2.

issues.description: The self-tapping screws are specified without an approved screw type, boss engagement depth or installation torque, risking cracked bosses or stripped threads.
issues.fix: Select a thread-forming screw for PC/ABS and validate pilot, engagement, torque and repeated assembly on moulded samples.
issues.rule_citation: Size plastic bosses and pilot holes to the selected thread-forming screw and verify installation torque — SPIROL design guidelines for self-tapping screws in plastics.

issues.description: The white LSR strap has no specified resistance to UV, saltwater, sunscreen or repeated flexing.
issues.fix: Specify an outdoor-grade LSR compound and acceptance tests for ageing, chemical exposure and flex fatigue.
issues.rule_citation: Evaluate weathering of nonmetallic materials under UV exposure — ASTM G154.

issues.description: Individual shell mating-face tolerances and the split-line limit do not define an achievable assembled stack-up, especially around the seal and sensor window.
issues.fix: Add assembly datums, a gap-and-flush stack-up, and functional tolerances for seal compression and window position.
issues.rule_citation: Define functional datums and tolerance relationships on assembly drawings — ISO 1101 and ISO 5459.

issues.description: Minimum wall draft is 1.33°: enough for a polished finish, short of the ~3° a textured finish ('MT-11010 light texture · Warm white #EDEBE6') needs.
issues.fix: Increase draft to 3° on textured faces, or specify a lighter texture / polished finish.
issues.rule_citation: Draft ≥1° plus 1° per 0.025 mm texture depth — Protolabs injection molding design guidelines; measured with text-to-cad DFM skill (mold_tool.py, MIT) ported to OCCT

issues.description: Projected area along +Z: 1250 mm² (part silhouette, per cavity). Estimated clamp force ≈ 6.4 t (Estimate: area in² × 3.0 t/in² for PC/ABS × 1.1 safety) — per cavity; a family tool moulding both shells in one shot roughly doubles it.

issues.description: The shell joint, screw holes, sensor window and charging contacts have no specified sealing method for saltwater use.
issues.fix: Define gaskets or overmoulded seals at every opening, control seal compression in the assembly drawing, and validate the assembled band to a specified ingress rating.
issues.rule_citation: Specify and test enclosure ingress protection for the intended exposure — IEC 60529.

issues.description: The LiPo battery has no specified protection circuit, retention method or clearance from screw tips and shell pinch points.
issues.fix: Specify a protected cell or battery protection circuit, a positive retention feature, and assembly clearances; qualify the complete battery assembly.
issues.rule_citation: Portable lithium battery safety requirements — IEC 62133-2.

issues.description: The self-tapping screws are specified without an approved screw type, boss engagement depth or installation torque, risking cracked bosses or stripped threads.
issues.fix: Select a thread-forming screw for PC/ABS and validate pilot, engagement, torque and repeated assembly on moulded samples.
issues.rule_citation: Size plastic bosses and pilot holes to the selected thread-forming screw and verify installation torque — SPIROL design guidelines for self-tapping screws in plastics.

issues.description: The white LSR strap has no specified resistance to UV, saltwater, sunscreen or repeated flexing.
issues.fix: Specify an outdoor-grade LSR compound and acceptance tests for ageing, chemical exposure and flex fatigue.
issues.rule_citation: Evaluate weathering of nonmetallic materials under UV exposure — ASTM G154.

issues.description: Individual shell mating-face tolerances and the split-line limit do not define an achievable assembled stack-up, especially around the seal and sensor window.
issues.fix: Add assembly datums, a gap-and-flush stack-up, and functional tolerances for seal compression and window position.
issues.rule_citation: Define functional datums and tolerance relationships on assembly drawings — ISO 1101 and ISO 5459.

issues.description: Minimum wall draft is 1.33°: enough for a polished finish, short of the ~3° a textured finish ('MT-11010 light texture · Pink #FFC0CB') needs.
issues.fix: Increase draft to 3° on textured faces, or specify a lighter texture / polished finish.
issues.rule_citation: Draft ≥1° plus 1° per 0.025 mm texture depth — Protolabs injection molding design guidelines; measured with text-to-cad DFM skill (mold_tool.py, MIT) ported to OCCT

issues.description: The screw-joined shells have no specified gasket or sealing method. Water can reach the PCB and battery during kitesurf use.
issues.fix: Add a continuous gasket and sealed screw and strap interfaces; define an ingress-protection target and verify the assembled product.
issues.rule_citation: Verify enclosure ingress protection using the IEC 60529 test methods.

issues.description: The optical sensor window and light seal are listed but have no specified mounting, compression, or water seal.
issues.fix: Define the window material, retention method, seal geometry, and compression limits; validate optical performance and sealing after assembly.
issues.rule_citation: Specify and validate sealing at enclosure openings — IEC 60529.

issues.description: The LiPo cell has no specified retention or routing, leaving it vulnerable to movement or pinching when the shells are screwed together.
issues.fix: Add a cell pocket or qualified adhesive, wire-routing features, and assembly clearance; specify a protected cell or protection circuit.
issues.rule_citation: Protect portable lithium cells against mechanical damage and electrical faults — IEC 62133-2.

issues.description: The exposed charging contacts have no specified plating or corrosion protection for saltwater use.
issues.fix: Specify marine-suitable contact plating and sealing, and validate charging reliability after salt-spray exposure.
issues.rule_citation: Use salt-spray testing to assess corrosion resistance — ISO 9227.

issues.description: The strap attachment hardware is listed but its geometry and assembly method are unspecified, so strap retention cannot be tooled or verified.
issues.fix: Define pins or fasteners, mating features, installation access, and a strap pull-test requirement.
issues.rule_citation: Define mating features and assembly access before tooling — Protolabs design for assembly guidance.

issues.description: Shell mating-face tolerances and the split-line step limit are specified independently, without an assembly datum scheme or stack-up accounting for screw clamping.
issues.fix: Define shared datums and critical cosmetic surfaces; perform an assembled stack-up and adjust tolerances or add alignment features.
issues.rule_citation: Establish datum references and evaluate tolerance accumulation for assemblies — ASME Y14.5.

issues.description: The pink textured exterior has no UV or sunscreen-resistance requirement despite prolonged outdoor wear.
issues.fix: Specify UV-stabilized, skin-contact-appropriate resin and colorant, then validate color and finish after UV and sunscreen exposure.
issues.rule_citation: Evaluate plastics exposed to sunlight using accelerated weathering — ISO 4892-2.
